Anyway, it seems you guys really got me out of a tight spot, not that it makes much of a difference because I'm going to hunt these shits down to the very last second.

Take this, pay Lotus, and keep the change.
6a6be0db93f4ebb01828169d successMessageT: Thank you for the help. And thank Lotus as well.
6a6bf9b4e9edcd20cefd27ad description:
Feeling alright?

We got everything sorted out pretty fast, don't you think? But listen, getting involved with a USEC isn't exactly cheap. There are too many people paying attention to this, and I don't intend to put my people at risk without some guarantee.

How about a contribution to cover the operation's costs? And just to be clear, I don't want my name involved in this.
6a6bf9b4e9edcd20cefd27ad successMessageT: So she was the one who silenced those Raiders? Hmm... interesting. Let's see where this goes.

From: Almen James

Sincerely, Almen James
Chief Researcher, TerraGroup Labs

69dc84fe5feb9cfd6040ee32 Description: An audio tape prepared by Kozlov for Anastasia. According to Kozlov's letters, it contains irrefutable proof of the city administration's ties to the local criminal underworld.
69dc85fa59d20caf8ecfcfc4 Description: The report from The Unheard states that their agents have already infiltrated government structures in multiple countries and hold influence beyond Russia.
69dc874ae348fd1fd7844b31 Description: Voronenko's report details the experiments TerraGroup conducted on humans in The Labyrinth.
69dedb462e45a1248bf6b96a Name: eTG-change Dual-Action upgraded regenerative stimulant injector
69dedb462e45a1248bf6b96a Description: A powerful stimulant for regeneration processes. It is used for rapid recovery of a soldier after injury, or during transportation of heavily wounded personnel. Allowed to be used only by medical officers and paramedics. Has strong side effects.
69e5613a079c7bc64a33bb77 Description: A clipboard with customs documents allowing the passage of vehicles with classified cargo, along with some explosive logs. The vehicles were owned by TerraGroup and had an itinerary stating they would later be unloaded on Shoreline. The clearance was signed and approved by two UNTAR officers.
69e5691d7508ab4bcec902dd Name: Letter from one of Ref's people
69e5691d7508ab4bcec902dd Description: A letter from one of Ref's associates detailing the outcome of an ambush plan on a TerraGroup freighter passing through the UNTAR roadblock on Woods. The operation was a failure, as they were intercepted by a specialized group before it even began. Only the sender of the letter survived the attack.
69e58c872c4f50f3899570be Name: TerraGroup and UNTAR Cargo and Transport Report
69e58c872c4f50f3899570be Description: A set of documents and photos regarding a long TerraGroup cargo transport with UNTAR. The documents log several C4 explosives under TerraGroup's name, as well as Western weaponry like HKs, M4A1s, around 5000 rounds of 5.56x45mm M995, 3000 rounds of 5.56x45mm SSA AP, and a few night vision devices.
69e58ee426845b37bdc250fd Description: A special hard drive sealed with a digital lock. Its contents must be highly important, which makes it suspicious that it was left behind.
69e90614c926337ef78d0730 Description: A two-handed axe made out of a sewer hatch... With that weight, a single blow is enough to split a skull, whether the blade is sharp or not.
69e97f550b197e4084c986f6 Name: First Spear Siege-R Optimized M.A.S.S. Plate Carrier (White Tusk Edition)
69e97f550b197e4084c986f6 Description: A Siege-R Optimized plate carrier equipped with the M.A.S.S. Shoulder System. Provides reliable all-around protection while offering ample workspace for equipment placement. Black version. (White Tusk Edition)
69e987f14aa57d074d451fc3 Name: LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (White Tusk Edition)
69e987f14aa57d074d451fc3 Description: A simple yet effective plate carrier by London Bridge Trading company. The most minimalistic design intended for use with chest rigs. Black version. (White Tusk Edition)
69e98f93bfb21d9384a9440c Name: LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (White Tusk Edition)
69e98f93bfb21d9384a9440c Description: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. Special configuration by Birdeye, member of the Goons squad. (White Tusk Edition)
69e993970ae63611e1b219d0 Name: Crye Precision CPC plate carrier (White Tusk Edition)
69e993970ae63611e1b219d0 Description: The CAGE PLATE CARRIER (CPC) offers unrivaled comfort and load support in a low profile plate carrier configuration. The system supports a range of different pouches. In this case, the configuration is made by the leader of the Goons squad - Knight - for conducting assault operations with increased mobility. (White Tusk Edition)
69e9a15b5e3782f47564fd86 Description: A helmet whose history traces back to one of the Arena’s greatest gladiators, who was defeated in combat by an unknown challenger. The helmet was recovered in battle and modified with new ornaments and special textured armor for Apex Squadron leader Loghan of ISB SOF.
69e9a2584f96ca8b30449811 Name: Modified Ballistic Armor Co. Bastion helmet (White Tusk Edition)
69e9a2584f96ca8b30449811 Description: The Bastion NIJ level IIIA tactical helmet designed for law enforcement and civilian use. Equipped with M-LOK interface rails for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Ballistic Armor Co. A model painted in a light silver camouflage finish with modified decals. Designed for Firefly, the leader of the Cipher squadron, from ISB SOF.
69e9a6ecb9a707df5df24b0d Name: Modified Diamond Age Bastion helmet armor plate
69e9a6ecb9a707df5df24b0d Description: An optional modular ballistic protection for the Diamond Age Bastion helmet. A model painted in light silver with stripes and a matte finish, featuring modified decals. Designed for Vipper of ISB SOF, leader of the Snake squadron.
69e9a740c5601070091d418b Name: Modified Diamond Age NeoSteel helmet ballistic mandible (White Tusk Edition)
69e9a740c5601070091d418b Description: An extra ballistic protection with a special design for the Diamond Age NeoSteel helmet. A model painted in a light silver camouflage finish with modified markings. Designed for Vipper, the leader of the Snake squadron, from ISB SOF.
69e9a8f20e957d2d8862225e Name: Modified Diamond Age NeoSteel High Cut helmet (White Tusk Edition)
69e9a8f20e957d2d8862225e Description: The Diamond Age NeoSteel helmet features a unique design that combines high-strength steel with composite materials to provide advanced protection against ballistic and impact threats. It is designed to withstand high velocity impacts and can provide protection against a variety of threats. A model painted in a light silver camouflage finish with modified markings. Designed for Vipper, the leader of the Snake squadron, from ISB SOF.
69eaf72c4cf2c393c76e0847 Description: A modified jammer capable of disrupting low- and very low-frequency communications, specifically the single-frequency signals commonly used in explosives.
69f058abe6c9802225abaf21 Description: A 60-round 5.56x45 SureFire MAG5-60 metal high capacity magazine.
69f0d28ca0c7d37d9130aab8 Name: AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG D-60 STANAG 60-round magazine (FDE)
69f0d28ca0c7d37d9130aab8 Description: The Magpul PMAG D-60 polymer 60-round magazine for 5.56x45 rounds.
69f0eb8c02bba0856602897e Name: AR-15 Griffin Armament M4SD-K 5.56x45 sound suppressor (FDE)
69f0eb8c02bba0856602897e Description: The M4SD-K sound suppressor, designed for use with 5.56x45 caliber weapon systems. Can only be installed on the SDQD mounting interface flash hiders. Manufactured by Griffin Armament.
69f0eb9054288f30f3789ec1 Description: The SilencerCo Saker ASR 556 sound suppressor, designed for use with 5.56x45 caliber weapon systems. Can be installed on ASR-compatible muzzle devices.
69f422093640de523b76ea42 Description: An analog radio frequency stabilizer commonly used to connect to highly encrypted frequency communication systems.
69f572b4492391522e8fb0de Description: A custom carbine based on the AR-15 platform, designed to combine modern ergonomics, high modularity, and the widespread availability of the 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge. Manufactured by Custom Guns, the NL15 Carbine features a direct-gas-operated bolt assembly, offering a lightweight, versatile, and reliable platform for close- to medium-range combat.
69f586053cad5a4bb4cd61ee Description: A custom assault rifle based on the AR-15 platform, designed to combine modern ergonomics, high modularity, and the performance of the .300 Blackout cartridge in close- to medium-range combat. Manufactured by Custom Guns, the NL15 features a bolt assembly and gas system tuned to provide reliable operation with both subsonic and supersonic ammunition, especially in configurations with a suppressor.
69f64ffa8aee7c5fc321dc70 Description: An upper receiver for the direct impingement NL545 assault rifle manufactured by Custom Guns. Equipped with a mount for attaching additional devices.
69f67aaf276f5880ea08136f Description: The MCX SPEAR is a multi-caliber assault rifle designed and manufactured by SIG Sauer based on the MCX assault rifle. Primarily chambered in the new 6.8x51mm (.277 FURY) ammunition. Designed specifically for the US Military to replace the M4 carbine.
69f68305a8eea15aea284ef9 Description: A 30-round double-stack L7AWM 30 magazine for 5.56x45 NATO ammunition. Manufactured by Lancer Systems.
69f683cb5fe79e067a85d9ef Description: A 25-round double-stack L7AWM 25 magazine for 5.56x45 NATO ammunition. Manufactured by Lancer Systems.
69f683f01b84e0c82074cadb Name: AR-10 5.56x45 X Products X-25 Modified 50-round drum magazine
69f683f01b84e0c82074cadb Description: A modified 50-round 5.56x45 drum magazine for the AR-10 platform weapons. Manufactured by X Products.
69fa52ff8196fcfde3e548b4 Description: The EOTech Vudu 1-6x24 riflescope, equally effective on AR platforms and bolt-action rifles. Its EOTech-style speed ring reticle is designed for fast target engagement at low power, while delivering the resolution and accuracy needed for longer range targets. FDE Version
69fa5313cc7338d9dec96f77 Description: The TANGO6T is a rugged and well-built low power variable optic. This model features a 1x to 6x magnification and a first focal plane reticle. This rifle scope is ideal for short and medium distances, as well as for backcountry hunting. Manufactured by SIG Sauer. Black Version
69fa8ea590bf94cacd7f5e38 Description: A Bulgarian 30-round 5.56x45 "Waffle Pattern" magazine for the SLR-106 civilian AK-based rifles. Manufactured by Circle 10 and distributed by Arsenal Inc. Black Version
69faa0d657249bee9c41f47b Description: A Bulgarian 30-round 5.56x45 "Waffle Pattern" magazine for the SLR-106 civilian AK-based rifles. Manufactured by Circle 10 and distributed by Arsenal Inc. FDE Version
69fb9d99f3104a4abd9e3c47 Description: M67 Fragmentation Hand Grenade is an American hand grenade, designed for antipersonnel combat purposes and adopted in 1969 by the army of the United States.
69fc2eed42c2198ea9ca68de Description: A tactical riflescope designed for quick target acquisition and maximum precision. Manufactured by Vortex Optics. FDE Version
69fca77d3a0b02c8aec59eb4 Name: ISB Modified Colt M4A1 5.56x45 Assault Rifle (FDE)
69fca77d3a0b02c8aec59eb4 Description: A modified variant of the Colt M4A1 carbine, adapted by ISB SOF for use in high-intensity special operations. This version replaces several standard components with optimized parts, including a re-engineered gas system, an improved bolt assembly, and reinforced internal components, resulting in a higher rate of fire without compromising the platform’s reliability.
69fcbf779ea8940faa793551 Description: An upper receiver for the M4A1 assault rifle manufactured by Colt. Equipped with a mount for attaching additional devices. Modified version designed to provide greater stability, improved recoil control, and ergonomic balance with additional mods. FDE Version
69fccb4b144b3ba3fde464bd Name: Modified AR-15 RTM ATP buffer tube (FDE)
69fccb4b144b3ba3fde464bd Description: The modified ATP buffer tube, 6-position, Mil-Spec diameter, will fit any AR-15-based carbine. Manufactured by RTM.
69fcd2dc03d8476407fb7ec0 Name: Modified AR-15 Geissele SMR MK16 13.5 inch M-LOK handguard (FDE)
69fcd2dc03d8476407fb7ec0 Description: The modified The Geissele SMR 13.5 inch M-LOK handguard for AR-15 equipped with an M-LOK interface for installation of additional devices and accessories. Desert Dirt Color version.
69fce4a63974614588b85dc7 Name: Mystery Ranch 2 Day Assault Pack (Olive Drab)
69fce4a63974614588b85dc7 Description: This Mystery Ranch backpack is designed for short missions of up to two days. Its compact size is offset by excellent ergonomics. External straps provide convenient attachment points for tools and gear you might need on the go.
69fd43ec50a5c7077199c905 Description: The Specter Holographic Combat Optic sight. Manufactured by ELCAN. Pink Version
69fd4c184b6b64d765f4634e Description: The SpecterDR (Dual Role) 1x/4x scope from Specter scope series designed by ELCAN has marked a breakthrough in the optic sight development by becoming the first variable scope that truly has two work modes, switching from 4x magnification to 1x in one touch. Also features a backup iron sight. TAN version.
6a01221f642040cc21286f0e Description: 6B47 is an aramid helmet of Russian origin. As part of the Ratnik program, it is the new standard-issue helmet for most of the Russian Armed Forces. The 6B47 is similar to previous generation helmets such as the 6B7-1M and 6B27. It has equal protection but weighs slightly less, floats in water, and has mounting equipment for lights and night vision devices. The helmet can be fitted with a variety of covers for different environments. Equipped with an black camouflage cover.
6a0132335800bd16221e79fd Name: Modified HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Black)
6a0132335800bd16221e79fd Description: A combat helmet with the ears and back of the head protection, manufactured by HighCom. Spray painted in a black style.
6a0136a1fae06fd4bbd20288 Name: Modified MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Black)
6a0136a1fae06fd4bbd20288 Description: The MSA Advanced Combat Helmet (ACH) delivers advanced ballistic, fragmentation, and impact head protection, with comfort for long-term use. The helmet’s low-profile design reduces the risk of interference in target acquisition and ensures compatibility with NVGs and headsets.
6a01375552833cf4cd0f2ea0 Description: A version of the MTEK STRIKE helmet with extended modularity. Black version.
6a07e9181d633a50969d3145 Name: FORT Defender-2 body armor (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e9181d633a50969d3145 Description: The FORT OK "Defender-2" operational kit is a modification of the popular body armor FORT "Defender" designed for both VIP and for employees of operational combat units. The kit uses the maximum capabilities of the modular principle of building armor based on steel plates. (ISB SOF)
6a07e91cbe3fc4e84a5e6fb2 Name: FORT Redut-M body armor (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e91cbe3fc4e84a5e6fb2 Description: “Redut-M” is a modified version of the well-proven Redut body armor, which is in service of special units of the FSB. The vest is based on advanced technologies in the field of individual armor. Due to the optimized form of armor elements and the outer cover with a special damping-ventilation system, the Redut M armored vest has excellent functional qualities, which facilitates active actions, including those associated with the use of vehicles and in confined spaces. (ISB SOF)
6a07e920d7a2c6d597db893c Name: NPP KlASS Korund-VM body armor (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e920d7a2c6d597db893c Description: The NPP KlASS Korund-VM heavy bulletproof vest, adopted by the units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia. (ISB SOF)
6a07e925f6c3b7986c02f80b Name: 6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e925f6c3b7986c02f80b Description: The 6B43 bulletproof vest is designed for protection from light weapon bullets - including BP and PP - fragments of grenades, mines, and melee weapons, as well as reducing the risk of after-penetration effects during combat situations. (ISB SOF)
6a07e928f6c73d88baf0d370 Name: Ars Arma A18 Skanda plate carrier (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e928f6c73d88baf0d370 Description: A plate carrier equipped with a set of pouches in assault configuration. Manufactured by Ars Arma. (ISB SOF)
6a07e92cf0655c4e29c5127e Name: ANA Tactical M2 plate carrier (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e92cf0655c4e29c5127e Description: The M2 vest is created with the use of the best experience of Russian special forces operators. The versatility of the system makes it possible to use this vest both when carrying out urban tasks and when performing tasks on rough terrain. Equipped with additional pouches for 8 magazines. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. (ISB SOF)
6a07e931698298899e8270e4 Name: S&S Precision PlateFrame plate carrier (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e931698298899e8270e4 Description: A plate carrier with a minimalistic, lightweight, semi rigid plastic design, which was configured by Big Pipe - member of the Goons squad. Manufactured by S&S Precision. (ISB SOF)
6a07e9346cb94e635eeaffb9 Name: Eagle Allied Industries MBSS plate carrier (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e9346cb94e635eeaffb9 Description: The MBSS vest is part of the Maritime Ballistic Survivor System. The vest can be used with flotation inserts to provide buoyancy as it is not equipped with a quick release system. Manufactured by Eagle Allied Industries. (ISB SOF)
6a07e93836380a0f34f772aa Name: Tasmanian Tiger Plate Carrier MKIII (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a07e93836380a0f34f772aa Description: A lightweight low-profile plate carrier designed to fit SAPI plates. Manufactured by Tasmanian Tiger. (ISB SOF)
6a0805a4f4ca65c231f2566b Name: Modified MSA Gallet TC 800 High Cut combat helmet (Black)
6a0805a4f4ca65c231f2566b Description: The MSA TC 800 ballistic helmet, designed for use by tactical teams of police special forces, in combat and reconnaissance operations. It can be modified by various components.
6a08060a7aace4c0c7377b99 Description: The Caiman Hybrid helmet is a new generation of lightweight special forces helmet. A series of modular accessories enhances the package, providing users with lightweight, comfortable and maximum head protection. Manufactured by Galvion.
6a080d584a66939befef7e05 Name: Modified Galvion Caiman Hybrid Ballistic Applique
6a080d584a66939befef7e05 Description: An additional up-armor helmet shell attachment to elevate or enhance ballistic and fragmentation protection of the Caiman Hybrid Helmet. Manufactured by Galvion.
6a0a5091eb733b78d06f82b2 Description: An access card belonging to a high-ranking executive at TerraGroup.
6a0c8252cdf53775685d923e Name: Crye Precision JPC Plate Carrier (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a0c8252cdf53775685d923e Description: The widely beloved Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) was designed to maximize operator mobility by reducing weight and bulk. Its modular system allows for personalized loadouts and quick gear adjustments depending on the mission. Manufactured by Crye Precision. MultiCam version. (ISB SOF)
6a0c8971059c31bc88b71651 Name: Modified LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig V2 (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau Version II)
6a0c8971059c31bc88b71651 Description: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. Special configuration by Birdeye, member of the Goons squad. (ISB SOF II)
6a0c8d060ae9d5ea831d93c9 Name: Direct Action Thunderbolt compact chest rig (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a0c8d060ae9d5ea831d93c9 Description: The Thunderbolt fixed chest rig, containing all the basic utility pouches you'd need. Manufactured by Direct Action. (ISB SOF)
6a0d09c36f85033057ae496a Name: Custom ISB SOF HighCom Trooper TFO body armor (Version II)
6a0d09c36f85033057ae496a Description: A plate armor vest by HighCom, popular among USEC PMCs. MultiCam camouflage version. (ISB SOF II)
6a111c7164b1373374405287 Name: Extended Tasmanian Tiger Modular Pack 45 Plus (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
6a111c7164b1373374405287 Description: The TT Modular Pack 45 is a system that can be customized to suit the user’s needs. The top flap can be raised to increase capacity or removed entirely if required. External straps allow attachment of bulky gear or equipment that needs to remain easily accessible. Black Version
6a11e1e951f16801020b4061 Description: The early generation of the tactical device called "RAPTAR" combined with a rangefinder. It has visible and IR lasers, as well as an infrared illuminator.

6a12667fec1b599645cd7183 Name: Extended Eberlestock F4 Terminator load bearing backpack (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)

6a126adc0d1adc1541f74ad4 Description: A large backpack that is perfect for the tourist on a raid.

6a222d3dc7ebe3f5fbc2b01d Description: An armored steel welding mask of Tagilla - the Bossman of Factory. Painted with the special "Swineherd" art.

6a279c95534fb23d302b6b27 Description: A military-grade gas mask for individual protection produced by JSC “Sorbent.”
6a279d1b7bb85ffaa461cd9e Description: A military-grade gas mask for individual protection produced by MSA.

6a27a0b9804ef665f75718ba Description: An access card belonging to a high-ranking executive at TerraGroup. No longer operational.

Equipped with two radios for communicating with both the assigned squad and HQ. (ISB SOF Enhanced)

6a30ec66d725140ed59cdd1c Description: A pack of 4.6x30mm DM11 ammo, 40 rounds.

6a4c68b8a90f66f581bf790f Name: FORT Gladiator-S plate carrier (White Tusk Lightweight)
6a4c68b8a90f66f581bf790f Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. White Tusk Lightweight version.

6a4d24532666085a03d7b1e3 Description: The HK MP7-SF is a submachine gun manufactured by Heckler & Koch that fires in semi-automatic mode. It is chambered for 4.6×30mm ammunition. It serves as an excellent compact, highly controllable weapon and is frequently used by the UK’s Ministry of Defense Police. This version has been modified to provide greater stability, better control, and the ability to fire in automatic mode.

6a4d5879b498ae06e3582412 Description: A helmet cover for Team Wendy EXFIL series helmets. The MultiCam Alpine camouflage is intended for snow operations.
6a4d5940473d4411b409b02a Description: A helmet cover for Team Wendy EXFIL series helmets. The MultiCam camouflage is intended for daytime operations.

6a66997ad3500a8799dfb257 Name: T H I C C Weapons Case, Labeled and Locked
6a66997ad3500a8799dfb257 Description: A very heavy weapon case left behind as part of a shipment. When you pick it up, it feels like it's packed full and is probably worth a lot
6a66cd3bbb61030ed6701699 Description: A Cardboard containing various documents from the investigation led by the BEAR Operator regarding TerraGroup. The documents are less conclusive than those of his FSB partner, but they report a contractual link between TerraGroup and a highly specialized security firm, and mention several intercepted emails referring to a "Cleanup Operation" scheduled to happen on the day of the final evacuation.
6a66cd3d30580e2e7433b853 Name: FSB Special Agent's UNTAR Investigation File
6a66cd3d30580e2e7433b853 Description: A Cardboard containing various documents and photos regarding an UNTAR officer known only by his title, "The Supervisor". The FSB agent conducted a detailed investigation into several approvals made by the UNTAR officer for vehicles transporting personnel and high-end equipment. Transports that were not listed in the official records.
6a6980af9994a65e2f0f7a55 Name: Transcript of a computer conversation between Aishi and an unknown person
6a6980af9994a65e2f0f7a55 Description: A document containing a transcript of a recorded conversation from Aishi on her personal computer. Information regarding the other participant in the conversation could not be found. Whoever recorded this is a true professional.
6a699b061078d7158cd6fc79 Name: Transcript of a conversation between Aishi and Knight
6a699b061078d7158cd6fc79 Description: A document containing a transcript recorded and transmitted by a tactical bug. Some markings on the original folder suggest that the bug was planted somewhere on Lighthouse.

6a6a208a35e0f5860094fa3d Description: An official document issued during the formation of the "New USEC" after KerniSEC and Safe Sea merged into a single company. It contains Juna Aishi's personal details as part of the recruitment plan for high-level officers to serve the corporation.
6a6a20af5df54b78cc3ecb91 Description: A document containing a transcript recorded and transmitted by a tactical bug. Some markings on the original folder suggest that the bug was planted somewhere on Lighthouse.
6a6a26c485ccac3917b1273c Name: Black notebook with information on Aishi and USEC ISB
6a6a26c485ccac3917b1273c Description: A notebook containing a few loose pages of documents related to Aishi, along with some additional intel that Lotus and her people compiled during their raids on Ground Zero.
6a6a3899fcb69bc1dec561a5 Name: A note issued by TerraGroup to its security division regarding USEC ISB
6a6a3899fcb69bc1dec561a5 Description: An official TerraGroup document forwarded to security division officers and top-level scientists, warning them to exercise caution regarding USEC ISB, its Director, and the personnel involved in the project. It mentions a "Black Division", a name not found in any official records.
6a6d234944cd24f0ae3243c6 Name: Sealed TerraGroup letter containing operational details
6a6d234944cd24f0ae3243c6 Description:
A sealed letter that was meant to be delivered to a TerraGroup official responsible for the last evacuation groups at the Terminal. 

[CONFIDENTIAL] DESTROY AFTER READING 

[CONFIDENTIAL] DESTROY AFTER READING 

[CONFIDENTIAL] DESTROY AFTER READING 

From: Almen James
To: Rostova Rais 

Good afternoon, Ms. Rais. The fact that I am writing this using our analog protocols already demonstrates the importance of this message. 

The evacuation is not over yet. I beg you, I implore you to reconsider and delay the start of the new phase of the cleanup operation. 

We have many scientists and employees awaiting evacuation. If the new contractors begin the operation, you know exactly what will happen—many important things will be lost, as well as lives. Please, delay the start of Operation CLEANUP. 

Sincerely, Almen James
Chief Researcher, TerraGroup Labs

blackdiv_banner Description: From time to time, rumors spread through Tarkov about a special unit that belongs neither to USEC nor BEAR. According to campfire stories, these special operatives conduct night-time operations to clear restricted facilities and extract valuable TerraGroup data. But among PMC operators, very few believe in the existence of this so-called "Black Division", because under the current circumstances, freely inserting and extracting entire combat groups through the blockade ring is practically impossible.
bloodhounds_banner Description: Mercenaries hired by individuals connected to the Arena to track down and hunt event fugitives. Aggressive and dangerous, they track their targets until they neutralize them.
cleanupcrew_banner Description: Reports indicate the presence of highly equipped squads patrolling certain common areas. Known as the "Cleanup Crew", they are a group hired by Ref, the Arena Host, to clear out areas designated to host his tournaments.
cultgang_banner Description: Little is known about the hooded men dressed in black. Some PMC reports mention a trio of heavily armed and aggressive Cultists. Known as "Oni", "Harbinger", and "Ghost", they attack anyone who threatens the territory controlled by the Cultists.
cultist_banner Description: Little is known about the Witnesses of the Arrival, the hooded figures conducting rituals and gathering in marked rooms at night. Their goals and beliefs remain a mystery even after years of activity in Tarkov.
icebreaker_cover Description: In the Gulf of Finland, trapped within the blockade surrounding Tarkov, lies the nuclear-powered icebreaker "Boreas", owned by the logistics corporation Paradigm Shipping. The exact purpose of "Boreas" and the cargo it carries remain unknown. It appears that Paradigm Shipping and TerraGroup made special efforts to minimize any mention of the icebreaker in the press and keep its routes and assignments classified.
isb_banner Description: The USEC Intelligence Support Bureau. It was formerly a special division of the USEC specializing in counterintelligence, infiltration, and special operations. Today, long after the USEC’s breakup and dissolution, not much is known about the Agency, but rumors suggest that the ISB has taken an independent position in Tarkov, and the current leader is looking to end the conflict using her own methods.
omon_banner Description: The Special Mobile Unit (Отряд мобильный особого назначения), also known simply as OMON, is an elite police force of the Russian Federation that operates in conjunction with the Russian National Guard. Known for their strict discipline and intensive training, they are frequently deployed to handle crisis situations and threats to public safety.
pillagers_banner Description: Hired by Skier to intercept and steal Ref's cargo while in transit. They are frequently outfitted with customized Arena gear, stolen from the ambushed shipments.
rem_banner Description: The Spetsnaz Remnants are a special operations force comprised of Spetsnaz GRU, SSO, FSB and Rosgvardia troops that were abandoned during the initial pull-out and containment of the Norvinsk Economic Region. As a faction, they operate entirely at night time follow a "shoot first, ask questions later" method of engagement towards anyone they are unfamiliar with.
rogues_banner Description: The Rogues are a group of mercenaries made up of former USEC members who formed after the events of “Blue Fire.” Little is known about their true motives. They are led by the “Goons” and are highly loyal to their commander, Knight.
ruaf_banner Description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation. The regular units of the Russian army that were deployed to Tarkov following the escalation of the armed conflict between the USEC and BEAR. Together with UNTAR, they blocked all routes into Tarkov and tightened the siege to contain the conflict within Tarkov.
smugglers_banner Description: A crew of smugglers who formed a sort of Smuggling Federation, establishing routes across various locations. Transporting PMCs and Scavs for steep sums of cash and cargo, they can be found in multiple locations either to conduct raids or simply do business.
untar_banner Description: A United Nations peacekeeping contingent is operating in Tarkov under an international mandate following the escalation of the conflict between USEC and BEAR, as well as the presence of looters and bandits throughout the region. Equipped with light gear but highly disciplined, they are attempting to stabilize a region in collapse while maintaining the siege alongside the RUAF.
wedge_banner Description: Reconnaissance and monitoring reports from the few PMC networks still active in Tarkov have indicated that several combat helicopters are moving toward the Gulf of Finland. Intercepted radio frequencies mention a codename: "The Wedge" Accompanied by a squad of operatives from some of the world’s most diverse special forces, such as the SAS and Mossad, Wedge is a senior Black Division operative in charge of a covert operation aboard the ship "Boreas" No one has come out alive to reveal their motives there.
wt_banner Description: Known as "March Squadron", the White Tusks are an elite special task force of the ISB. Composed of the agency’s best operatives, as well as a few others who have been reassigned, they are known as Aishi’s true and only punishment for all of Tarkov. They are rarely seen in the field, but when they are, everyone knows they are carrying out a high-risk mission or simply executing a “Sentence”.

6a8f39899225d6a63dd472a1 Description: A reinforced briefcase containing ISB documents and items. It has an electronic lock and is believed to contain sensitive information.
6a8f29c48faabd7edce25062 Description: A reinforced briefcase containing ISB documents and items. It has an electronic lock and is believed to contain sensitive information.
6aa5ff857a930fba7793141b Name: ISB Model KW12 Advanced Modified SSTV Radio
6aa5ff857a930fba7793141b Description: A modified radio that transmits on an ‘ISB’ encoded frequency. It is capable of emitting low-power signals that are undetectable by other devices. Perfect for internal team communication.
4d57eab7724cdd35474d84eb Description: A modified battery capable of delivering a high enough electrical discharge to temporarily power devices. Highly volatile and sensitive.
6a8f0a4350e8e920dd389fd7 Description: A dog tag used by low-ranking ISB operatives. Unlike an identification dog tag, it appears to be used more as a trophy. Reconditioned from operatives of another unit.
6a8f0e0be1730357d098267b Description: A dog tag used by specialized ISB operatives. Unlike an identification dog tag, it appears to be used more as a trophy. Reconditioned from operatives of another unit.
6a8f540c650b4dbe25badff8 Description: A dog tag used by specialized ISB operatives. Unlike an identification dog tag, it appears to be used more as a trophy. Reconditioned from operatives of another unit.
6a8f1e073b022db2a04c1b76 Description: A dog tag used by specialized ISB operatives. Unlike an identification dog tag, it appears to be used more as a trophy. Reconditioned from operatives of another unit.
6a8f1e1f60f1022c46406c5b Description: A dog tag used by high-ranking ISB operatives. Unlike an identification dog tag, it appears to be used more as a trophy. Reconditioned from operatives of another unit.
6a8f1e3beb9811b096e224c3 Description: A dog tag used by ISB Leaders. Unlike an identification dog tag, it appears to be used more as a trophy. Reconditioned from operatives of another unit.
6a8cff3621e52fbbd04f4113 Description: Rumor has it that TerraGroup keeps a personnel file on nearly every PMC operator. Judging by these documents, the rumors are true.
6a8cfc98ca0eb181f2df0059 Description: Financial reports from TerraGroup and its affiliated companies. There's bound to be plenty of inconsistencies and evidence hidden inside, but are you really willing to spend hours of your life reading dry financial paperwork?
6a8cfca2e34752ad44304cd6 Description: Documentation from Tarkov Infraline. The company officially specialized in road construction, but these blueprints clearly have nothing to do with transportation infrastructure.
6a8e765f2bee6c4abdb52713 Description: Blueprints and technical documentation belonging to TerraGroup. For convenience, all of the data has also been backed up onto a disk.
6a8e76785c3f75a6b4455e41 Description: Documents detailing tests of various experimental compounds from TerraGroup-controlled laboratories. It's surprising they've managed to remain in Tarkov at all.
6a8e76b6fd6a7d4953c567cc Description: Documentation issued to every new TerraGroup employee upon signing. It contains both useful information and the obligatory, mind-numbing office rules like how to chip in for a coworker's birthday gift.
6a8e76ea2c551db921771c4f Description: Medical records containing research findings. Many of them are ethically questionable, yet remarkably successful in every other regard. Truth is in the eye of the beholder.
6a8e770988343498f639d557 Description: Operating manuals for TerraGroup equipment. Essential for anyone who'd rather not lose a few fingers or break machinery worth millions of dollars. Or for anyone looking to make a tidy profit.
6a8e772b8dc2aa06f80099e4 Description: Classified information that somehow survived against all odds. Arguably the most valuable thing left in Tarkov.
6a8f2f19785af4cc71c3b8e2 Description: A high-performance tablet with a large screen. Built for durability and an operating system optimized for military operations.
6a8f3078020049bfa86a8f4a Name: Improvised ISB device for hacking systems
6a8f3078020049bfa86a8f4a Description: A makeshift device used to hack small electronic devices, intercept radio communications, electrical controllers, and wireless networks.
6a8f316e428d01f93b84c6dc Name: Unknown US Army Special Group Golden Badge
6a8f316e428d01f93b84c6dc Description: An insignia used by a US Army special operations group that carried out a secret operation in Tarkov.
6a8f332eff53d07351a35f93 Description: A container holding experimental chemicals. Sealed, it appears to be unstable, and it's definitely not a good idea to mess with it.
6a8f38698a6847c4a8bb6527 Description: A reinforced box containing valuable items and documents. Unpack it in the stash to receive five random items. The box is consumed when opened.
c5c72a7a3bf1f02421a145bb Description: An anomalous containment box. It contains anomalous items that were under investigation by TerraGroup. The contents of the box may be dangerous and unstable.
05c26946e5101112654ff5c0 Description: A sealed weapon case. It includes weapons used by the ISB, as well as modified versions of those weapons.
7684785c71295a7292ce6897 Description: The 6B45 body armor, designed to protect personnel from shrapnel and small arms fire. Part of the Ratnik equipment system and has been in production since the 2010s as a replacement for the 6B43 model. Red Right Hand version.

[CONFIDENTIAL] [ACCESS LEVEL 8] | EMERGENCY PROTOCOL III

Hello, Dr. Harp!

C.A.S.S.I.E. is programmed to activate the decontamination system in the event of a Level 10 containment breach—particularly in cases involving Euclids and Keter.

If the decontamination process begins, evacuate yourself and your team immediately. USEC operators will assist you with the procedure, as once decontamination begins, the facility will be flooded with concentrated carbon monoxide, which will asphyxiate any creature or biological entity.

If this is a false alarm, please check your personal control panel; you will receive an emergency code to deactivate the procedure.

Thank you for your attention!

Klen March, TerraGroup Researcher.

ISB/Office/KteIntroduction:
Hello, Dr. Harp!

I am forwarding the list of KTEs based on last week’s research. We were unsuccessful with most of the items, but we have cataloged the properties of 5 of them.
ISB/Office/KteBrief044: Contact with the object appears to increase carrying capacity and endurance. Repeated unexplained injuries have also been recorded; prolonged exposure is not recommended.
ISB/Office/KteBrief070: Following injection, test subjects show a sustained loss of mobility. No beneficial properties have been identified.
ISB/Office/KteBrief076: Keeping the object nearby causes recurring injuries in apparently random parts of the body. The source of the damage remains unidentified.
ISB/Office/KteBrief094: Contact produces extraordinary physical aggression and rapid recovery, including reduced hunger and thirst. Recurrent episodes of severe bleeding make unsupervised exposure unacceptable.
ISB/Office/KteBrief101: The object appears to materialize roubles at regular intervals. Further research is needed to identify the origin of the currency.
ISB/Office/KteBrief111: Test subjects carrying the object can jump substantially higher. Periodic exhaustion, hunger and thirst require continued observation.
ISB/Office/KteBrief135: Exposure rapidly depletes the subject's energy and hydration. No compensating benefits have been observed.
ISB/Office/KteBrief166: The object promotes gradual healing and appears to strengthen already recovered body tissue. The additional resilience does not persist after the exposure period.
ISB/Office/KteBrief218: Records indicate that the disk can preserve the subject's equipment following death. A single disk is consumed when this property activates; the retrieval mechanism remains unexplained.
ISB/Office/KteBrief229: Subjects carrying the object experience a pronounced loss of movement speed. No other useful properties have been cataloged.
ISB/Office/KteBrief292: Injection enables perception of heat signatures for the remainder of the field test. Persistent pain accompanies the effect.
ISB/Office/KteBrief294: Keeping the object nearby allows the subject to see in darkness without conventional night-vision equipment. No adverse effects have been observed so far.
ISB/Office/KteBrief325: The object causes periodic localized injuries without external contact. Head injuries have not been recorded in these tests.
ISB/Office/KteBrief430: Following injection, subjects can see in darkness for the remainder of the field test. Persistent pain prevents classification as a harmless substance.
ISB/Office/KteBrief435: The object appears to materialize euros at regular intervals. The resulting currency has been isolated for further examination.
ISB/Office/KteBrief501: Proximity to the object causes tunnel vision and fatigue. Consumption is not required for these symptoms to appear.
ISB/Office/KteBrief540: Exposure produces continuous injuries throughout the body. Immediate separation from the object is recommended.
ISB/Office/KteBrief572: The object suppresses exhaustion, hunger and thirst. Recurring injuries have also been observed and require medical supervision.
ISB/Office/KteBrief598: Subjects carrying the object inflict unusually severe injuries during controlled tests. The effect's mechanism remains unknown.
ISB/Office/KteBrief611: The object can interrupt an otherwise fatal injury, repair damaged limbs and briefly protect and heal the subject. It is consumed on activation; repeated protection with the same device is impossible.
ISB/Office/KteBrief636: When worn over the face, the object provides substantial ballistic protection. Repeated brief episodes of complete loss of vision have been recorded.
ISB/Office/KteBrief642: The object appears to reproduce the effects of Propital at regular intervals without being consumed. No negative properties have been identified so far.
ISB/Office/KteBrief663: Injection suppresses pain for the remainder of the field test. No negative properties have been observed so far.
ISB/Office/KteBrief665: Following injection, subjects display apparently inexhaustible stamina alongside continuous injuries throughout the body. Sustained exposure is dangerous.
ISB/Office/KteBrief722: The object rapidly restores the subject's stamina despite its unusually low apparent weight. Further tests are needed to explain this behavior.
ISB/Office/KteBrief787: Proximity induces a Berserk state in the subject. No negative properties have been identified in the current records.
ISB/Office/KteBrief863: Keeping the object nearby substantially reduces injuries from external attacks. Hunger and thirst increase throughout exposure.
ISB/Office/KteBrief876: Subjects carrying the object become unable to jump. The restriction ceases when contact ends; no benefits have been cataloged.
ISB/Office/KteBrief887: At close range, the object can unlock secured doors without their keys. Its capacity is limited and the object disappears when depleted.
ISB/Office/KteBrief949: Subjects carrying the object show an unexplained increase in jumping height. No adverse properties have been recorded so far.
ISB/Office/KteBrief952: Following injection, subjects sustain significantly less damage from external attacks for several minutes. No adverse effects have been recorded so far.
ISB/Office/KteBrief991: Contact prevents jumping and severely impairs movement speed. No beneficial properties have been identified.
ISB/Office/KteBrief199: Following injection, a supernatural increase in various properties of the human body is noticeable. Safety testing required.
ISB/Office/KteBrief652: Injection not recommended. Appears to cause extreme discomfort in every way.
ISB/Office/KteBrief664: Somehow appears to materialize dollars. Further research is needed to identify any negative effects.
ISB/Office/KteBrief711: Friendly appearance. Records and tests on test subjects indicate that keeping the object nearby causes various positive, protective effects.
ISB/Office/KteBrief728: Test subjects exposed to KTE 728 report extreme discomfort, panic attacks, and anxiety.

a3b3fae920584af7b941a2fc description:
Hello, soldier! How's it going?

It seems that "ISB" woman got herself into a big mess. Jaeger updated me a bit on the situation, and it looks like several highly dangerous chemicals are almost spiraling out of control.

Some unknown mercenaries are carrying special antidotes, and they could be very effective for some research. Get me a few of them, and I can help with this whole containment effort.
a3b3fae920584af7b941a2fc successMessageT: These antidotes will save lives. Thank you.
6e49a30eafa8409bbf623897 description:
Hello again!

I sent some of my people to do recon in The Lab, and I really don't know how you're handling all of this so easily. Well, some TerraGroup documents are quite interesting. They were studying not only this virus, but something they call "KTE" (Unknown Threat Entity)—items that somehow possess very strange properties. Hard to believe, isn't it? Well, I want to research some, so bring me a few samples.
6e49a30eafa8409bbf623897 successMessageT: I will study these objects carefully. You've brought us a valuable clue.
35dc82a3c84b4c0a8a0646d8 description: Mechanic contacted me. We found out that this C.A.S.S.I.E. system is fully automated to handle crises. Not even our adversaries are controlling it, and this could cause catastrophic problems for our operation. I've prepared a quite fun countermeasure for this, but it seems we'll need some of our opponents' equipment. Their encryption data is very useful against C.A.S.S.I.E. Assemble our device and let's move on.
35dc82a3c84b4c0a8a0646d8 successMessageT: You found their SSD? Great! We can proceed now.
a3af356391b41f8f5c97efcf: Prepare the modified flash drive with the virus to attack C.A.S.S.I.E.
10413f0d043844c6a69a88db description:
With the system virus ready, we can move forward. It seems the system operates with two passwords. The first is the general research manager's password, and we are trying to crack it and contact the scientist around the clock. The second password, C.A.S.S.I.E. sends automatically when an emergency is detected.

Place the modified flash drive with the virus in the lower server wing, then look for the main office; that might help expose the password!
10413f0d043844c6a69a88db successMessageT: Good job! Did you find the password?

scourge_squad_banner Description: Reports indicate that a special team was sent by Ref to the Laboratory to collect some stimulants. Led by a mercenary known only by his codename, “Scourge,” he was a TerraGroup employee who specialized in highly unstable chemicals and research products. Highly equipped and heavily armed, Scourge's team leaves no one who crosses their path alive.
